name: Stephen Gray Racing
location: Copper Belt Lodge, near Palmerston North, New Zealand
bio:
Stephen Gray Racing operates from Copper Belt Lodge, the private training centre owned by Stephen Gray and his father, veteran horseman Kevin Gray. Located near Palmerston North, it provides Stephen with top facilities as he rebuilds a boutique, high-performance stable in New Zealand after 24 years training in Singapore.

With access to quality facilities and a revived domestic racing scene, SGR is the base for Stephen's return to NZ racing — bringing international experience, deep horsemanship, and long-term vision back to where it all began.

name: Wexford Stables
bio:
Wexford Stables is a name synonymous with excellence in New Zealand racing history. Founded by Hall of Fame trainer Dave O'Sullivan, the legacy continues today under the leadership of Lance O'Sullivan ONZM and Andrew Scott.

Operating out of world-class facilities in Matamata, Wexford Stables maintains one of the best strike rates in the country. The stable has produced over 600 winners and multiple Group 1 champions.

name: Logan Racing
bio: Logan Racing is the trainer for the Almanzor x Night Danza filly, a coming-soon B.A.X Bloodstock horse. The website is currently in a spell ("having a spell; will be back in work soon") but the stable is active on social media.
